segments.text: Hello, Marcus. This is Sarah from Alpenline. How can I help?
Hi, Sarah. We need 2,500 STM32 controllers for the new board.
The production run starts in three weeks, so delivery is critical.
Understood. I will check the supplier and send you a date by Thursday.
Good. Price is less important this time, but please do not be late again.
I will also look for an alternate part in case stock is short.
Perfect. You can reach me on my mobile, 06601234.
